description:
🇬🇧 English

We are building RAUMREISE X, an immersive space-experience project. We are looking for creative and motivated team members with skills in AI, software development, 3D design, VR/AR and marketing. Let’s bring space closer to everyone!

🇩🇪 Deutsch

Wir entwickeln RAUMREISE X, ein immersives Weltraumerlebnis. Wir suchen kreative und motivierte Teammitglieder mit Kenntnissen in KI, Softwareentwicklung, 3D-Design, VR/AR und Marketing. Gemeinsam bringen wir das Weltall näher!
summary: We change the way farmers predict the future! Because your field deserve its climate forecast
details: Pick a location or draw your field and see how the climate has shifted since 1990, what the next three years are likely to bring, and which crop rotation holds up best.
dataRefs: SMAP L4 Root Zone Soil Moisture
